data.exact_reserve_text: The change in claims outstanding includes the impact of strengthening of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 7,637k (2022: release of GBP 87k). These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The contract had a favourable impact on the prior year underwriting loss of GBP 9.3m, which decreased the 2023 combined ratio by 2.8% to 86.7% from 89.5%. It provides additional protection against significant deterioration of prior accident year reserves up to $450m above the group reserves held at the time of the transaction.

named_events.loss_description: Exposures relating to the Russia and Ukraine conflict have been reviewed and Aspen has identified impacted policy holders and potential claims, and examined received claims. Although further claims resulting from the conflict are possible, we have made reasonable provision for all potential claims identified to date.
Exposures are being assessed following the ongoing conflict seen in Israel and Gaza. However, these are not expected to be material for the Syndicate.
The pandemic is now well understood and is not expected to impact the Syndicate going forward.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 77.144 million in 2023, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This translates to a 6.088% strengthening relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. The net prior year development, after the protection provided by the Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT), was a strengthening of GBP 7.637 million. Causes for reserve movements include the impact of higher economic and social inflation on loss costs, challenges from the economic environment, international conflicts such as the Russia and Ukraine conflict and the Israel and Gaza conflict, and financial market volatility. The LPT, effective from 2021 and covering 2019 and prior accident years, had a favourable impact of GBP 9.3 million on the prior year underwriting loss, mitigating some of the adverse development.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior year reserves within the Management Best Estimate were subject to only marginal movement in the year post loss portfolio transfer (LPT) recoveries in aggregate.
The Management Best Estimate includes an explicit uplift in respect of the potential impact of higher inflation on loss costs.
In the current year, the contract had a favourable impact on the prior year underwriting loss of GBP 9.3m
any deterioration on 2019 and prior accident year reserves in the Syndicate due to inflation or other reasons, are fully recoverable.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The reported net prior year development of GBP 7.637m strengthening (page 19) differs significantly from the net claims development triangle calculation of GBP 81.352m strengthening. This discrepancy is likely due to the impact of the Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and other accounting adjustments not fully captured by a simple triangle calculation. The LPT itself had a favourable impact of GBP 9.3m on prior year underwriting loss.
